race.comment: TOMANADO (5) struck a heavy track first-up at Kyneton and did a fair job to be beaten under two lengths. Has raced at or around today's trip 12 times for five wins. Strips fitter and with the help of the inside alley he finds an ideal second-up scenario. ANGLING FOR INFO (1) overcame early interference to work home into fourth when fresh from a spell over 1200m at Wagga last time out. Has 62kgs to manage but strips fitter and did finish in the money here at this trip at his only attempt. SANTOLINI (7) continued her excellent run of form when she came from a long way back to take out a similar race to this here 13 days ago. Brodie Loy has won two from two aboard and he is in the saddle again. Getting up in the weights but another victory is not out of reach. TESSARION (8) returns from a 29-week spell. Will be better in time over more ground but while fresh she is a sneaky chance. OPETAIA (11) flashed home first-up over 900m here. This looks a lovely second-up assignment.
